subject: English
passage: A leading expert in the field of ethnomusicology (the study of music in cultural contexts), ______ may be just as important to understanding traditional practices as those of well-documented musical forms.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: recordings of oral musical traditions, Kanani Akana argued in a 2018 study,
choices.B: Kanani Akana argued in a 2018 study that recordings of oral musical traditions
choices.C: it was argued in a 2018 study by Kanani Akana that recordings of oral musical traditions
choices.D: a 2018 study—by Kanani Akana—argued that recordings of oral musical traditions

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the noun phrase "Kanani Akana" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "a leading expert…contexts." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that Kanani Akana—and not another noun in the sentence—is a leading expert in the field of ethnomusicology.
